about: radio cells split the box by the cumulative cell formula in both directions (columns left to right, then rows), with the same gap both ways; each cell draws a 2 px ring of diameter min(cell height, 32) on its left, a filled dot 10 px smaller for the value item, then its text 8 px after the ring, left-aligned by default; a disabled radio is covered with dots after (cell boxes probe-confirmed)
